subject: Advent Spoiler Day 21!! LOOK AT ME!!!
author: ZombieTron
body:
OMG its the Photo's from Xandu and my visit to Criterion!!! 😳

edit - OK I'm breathing normally again so I will tell you what the pics are.

The first one is Xandu playing Paradise with me watching, I am wearing a visitors pass and you can see the infamous white boards in the background behind the snack table.

The second Pic is us with some of the Burnout team, that's Hamish Young wearing an Original Burnout T-shirt.

The third is me playing Revenge by the looks of it, we wanted to show Criterion the impact of Drift Jumping. And I needed a haircut! terrible pictures of me, but anyway!

The last one is us out to dinner with the Burnout Team from left to right - me, Xandu, Fiona Sperry, Craig Sullivan, Hamish Young and Steve Watt (hope I got all the names right!)

Alex Ward took all of the Photos. 

Good Memories! haha I can't believe those photos are up for everyone to see!! 😳

Edit - Fiona's name has now been corrected. Thanks for the info Alex, my memory is awful! One letter out isn't too bad!

--- The Original and the Best ---
